notes:
Coverage: this package binds the card's first entry symbol, soulsgym.envs.darksouls3.iudex:IudexEnv; the other three registered environments are not covered. IudexImgEnv is image-only (its observation is the game image array, so a driver for it would stop with NEEDS_ARTIFACTS), IudexEnvDemo is the demo variant and VordtEnv is a different boss. The fake is a pure Python analytic F0 stand-in, not the game: it was not compared with a real Dark Souls III run, and the upstream sim path (gymnasium.make after importing soulsgym) was not run because it needs a running game on Windows or Linux under Proton/Wine. Every game or episode value in fake.py is placeholder test data; the named constants are marked placeholder and the facts cite the clone. The 3000-step truncation is the registration's max_episode_steps, which gymnasium.make applies as a TimeLimit wrapper; the fake reports it directly. Warnings left as expected: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only queues the next reset, so the Gymnasium bridge makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings on the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.index and the two seed inputs (the catalogue world classes carry no unit for them). No hardware backend and no hardware run; the package is model-authored and unreviewed.
